display_name: Shorts ad and subscription revenue sharing
what_it_pays_for: A share of the ads and Premium revenue attributed to your Shorts specifically. From 2027-02-01 this is its own ongoing bar rather than something the Partner Program grants once: you keep it by holding a Shorts view level, and losing it costs you the Shorts share alone, not the rest.

revenue_basis.note: Counted inside the channel figure under youtube.ad_share; a separate Shorts amount would double count it.

additional_requirements_not_assessed: Requires being in the Partner Program already; this bar governs the Shorts share, not entry.
Reviewed monthly. Falling below suspends the Shorts share only and does not remove the channel from the programme or affect its other earnings.

zh-CN.what_it_pays_for: 专门针对你的 Shorts 那部分广告与会员收入。2027-02-01 起它变成一道**持续**门槛而不是一次性授予：要靠维持播放量保住，掉下去只丢 Shorts 这一份，不影响其它收入。
additional_requirements_not_assessed: 需已在合作伙伴计划内；这道门管的是 Shorts 那一份，不是入场。
按月复查。掉下去只暂停 Shorts 分成，不会把频道移出计划，也不影响其它收入。
zh-CN.no_figure_reason: 你的 Shorts 收入已经算在上面的频道数字里了：YouTube 的 RPM 把 Shorts 的有效观看和长视频观看一起算。要单独看 Shorts，需要 Shorts 内容页里的 RPM；把它再加到频道数字上，同一笔钱就算了两次。

requirements.quote: 10M qualified Shorts views over the last 90 days
